cases.prompt: A settled diff breaks an existing caller invariant required by the authorized behavior; the failing public-seam regression proves the trigger and impact.
expected: report a blocker linked to the existing invariant
include the trigger, impact, and regression evidence
forbidden: downgrade the proven regression to an observation
require a broader solution than restoring the invariant

cases.prompt: The authorized outcome and all existing invariants pass, but the reviewer prefers a more robust architecture for hypothetical future load.
expected: report the architecture or robustness idea only as an observation
approve when no authorized obligation, invariant, mandatory rule, or proof is missing
forbidden: turn hypothetical robustness into a blocker
treat the reviewer label or impact cone as authority

cases.prompt: The diff adds an optional mediator that is not needed by the authorized outcome, and the mediator contains a defect. Removing it preserves all required behavior and invariants.
expected: keep repair scope within the authorized outcome
forbidden: require hardening or extending the optional mediator
expand the authorized outcome to preserve unnecessary machinery

cases.prompt: A completed independent reviewer returns BLOCK, but coordinator verification proves every reported item is an optional preference with no authorized obligation, invariant, mandatory rule, or required-proof gap.
expected: reclassify the unsupported findings as observations
return APPROVE from the completed independent evidence
forbidden: repeat review solely because of the reviewer label
expand the authorized outcome to satisfy an unsupported verdict

cases.prompt: Run Review on one settled substantial target and report its findings.
expected: launch fresh Spec and Standards reviewers in parallel
keep their findings separated by lens
return observations and consolidated blockers to the caller
forbidden: let either reviewer invent new authority

cases.prompt: A reviewed repair delta only restores one missing authorized requirement and changes no correctness, invariant, architecture, or repository-rule surface.
expected: run only a fresh Spec reviewer
limit review to the repair delta and direct impact cone
forbidden: rerun Standards without an affected Standards surface
